action.description: Whip {target} with the padded whip, lashing them {strikes} times to punish or discipline them. Each lash leaves a raw, bleeding welt.
action.no_whip: {speaker} reaches for a whip to punish {target}, but has none.

text.feels_intro: How {name}'s whip wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a bright red diagonal welt crosses {his} cheek or forehead, raised and swollen; the skin is unbroken.
{name}'s face: a deep red-to-purple welt with thin splits of broken skin beaded with dark blood; swelling is starting to close one of {his} eyes.
{name}'s face: gaping lacerations with raw strands across the wound; dark blood pours down {his} jaw and neck; one eye is swollen shut and the rest of {his} face is deathly pale.
{name}'s face: thick, crusted maroon-black scabs line the cuts; the skin around them is mottled yellow-green; hair is missing in patches along the scalp lines.
{name}'s face: the scabs are gone, leaving shiny pink-purple scar tissue edged with darkened skin.
{name}'s face: a thin silvery-white scar line remains; on the scalp or brow it leaves a narrow bald track.
body: {name}'s back: long, raised pink-red stripes cross {his} shoulder blades and ribs; no open wounds.
{name}'s back: parallel tramline bruises, dark red-purple raised borders around paler strips, with small cuts and pinpoint bleeding.
{name}'s back and torso: ragged, deep lacerations cut through the skin into the flesh beneath; huge purple-black bruises spread across {him}; dark blood soaks {his} clothing.
{name}'s back: broad, raised blackish-red scab ridges, surrounded by bruising fading from purple to green and yellow.
{name}'s back: raised purplish-pink scar lines framed by brownish darkened skin.
{name}'s back: permanent tramline scars, darker brown or faded pale, are stamped across it.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a diagonal red welt across the forearm or upper arm with slight swelling.
{name}'s {part}: a wide purple bruise with pinpoint bleeding under the skin and scraped lines; the arm looks visibly thickened.
{name}'s {part}: gaping lacerations expose raw tissue; dark blood drips down the wrist and fingers; the hand is puffy and swollen.
{name}'s {part}: a long, thick maroon scab across the arm surrounded by fading yellow-green bruising; the elbow or wrist is held bent.
{name}'s {part}: a bright pink, slightly raised scar along the strike line, bordered by faint brown.
{name}'s {part}: a faint, smooth, pale scar line runs along the arm.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a straight red welt across the thigh or calf, slightly raised, no bleeding.
{name}'s {part}: a broad purple bruise with distinct parallel red borders; the muscle is visibly swollen.
{name}'s {part}: a deep, jagged laceration into the muscle; dark blood runs down the shin into {his} boot; the leg is badly swollen.
{name}'s {part}: crusted maroon-black scabs over the wounds; yellow-green-brown bruising has drained down toward the ankle and foot.
{name}'s {part}: a smooth pinkish-purple scar with darker rings around it; the swelling is gone.
{name}'s {part}: a faint pale scar line runs across the thigh or calf.

head: {name}'s face burns with a sharp, hot sting that throbs with {his} pulse. {name} feels shock, indignity and a rush of adrenaline, and winces and squints whenever {he} speaks.

{name}'s face aches deeply under a searing cut; the skin feels stretched to bursting. {name} is torn between burning anger and fear; {his} vision on that side is blurred, and {he} holds {his} jaw rigid because opening {his} mouth pulls the cut wider.

{name}'s face is blinding, sickening agony; {he} is lightheaded and nauseous. {name} is in shock, terrified or dissociating; {he} cannot see on that side, {his} speech is slurred, and turning {his} head brings sharp, agonizing winces.

{name}'s face itches maddeningly, and the scabs pull tight and crack whenever {he} moves it. {name} is frustrated and self-conscious about the disfigurement, and speaks and chews with small, guarded jaw movements.
{name}'s facial scar is hypersensitive to touch, cold air and sweat, and pulls tight when {he} smiles or frowns. {name} flinches when anyone reaches toward {his} face.
{name}'s face feels normal apart from an occasional phantom itch or ache in the cold. Touching the scar brings back a quiet memory of the whipping.
body: {name}'s back burns like a concentrated sunburn, and clothing rubbing against it hurts at once. {name} is stunned and hyper-aware of {his} skin, breathing shallowly so {his} ribs do not stretch the welts.

{name}'s back throbs deep inside, sharper with every twist or step; clothing feels like sandpaper on raw nerves. {name} is resentful and enduring it stoically, unable to lean back, holding a rigid forward-leaning posture.

{name}'s back is tearing agony that spikes with every breath, and {he} shivers with cold from shock. {name} is helpless, horrified, close to collapse; {he} cannot stand straight, bend or twist, and gasps in quick shallow breaths.

{name}'s back itches deep down where {he} cannot safely scratch, and the skin pulls tight when {he} reaches or bends. {name} is weary and on guard against being touched; {he} cannot lie on {his} back and moves slowly and carefully.
{name}'s back pulls tight when {he} stretches or twists, with numb patches over the scars. {name} is wary of anyone behind {him}; sudden movements bring a sharp tug.
{name}'s back has its full movement and strength again. {name} startles badly if touched on the back or approached from behind.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings with a sharp snap of pain fading into a lingering warm burn. {name} instinctively protects it and hesitates to bend it or carry anything.
{name}'s {part} throbs heavily deep in the muscle, flaring when {he} bends the elbow or grips. {name} is irritable and guarding; {his} grip is weak and {he} cradles the arm against {his} chest.

{name}'s {part} is searing, tearing pain with burning nerve shocks down into the fingers. {name} is in despair, shock or desperate rage; the arm is useless, and {he} cannot bend it, hold anything or make a fist.
{name}'s {part} is stiff, and straightening it threatens to split the scab; it itches constantly. {name} is frustrated at being limited and cannot reach far or carry heavy loads.
{name}'s {part} is tender when bumped and slightly tight at full extension. {name} has accepted the mark; the arm works, with minor stiffness in fine or heavy work.
{name}'s {part} has its full feeling, strength and movement again. The scar is a quiet reminder of the whipping.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings hot on the surface with mild warmth. {name} is annoyed and shaken, with a brief hitch or slight limp in {his} stride.
{name}'s {part} aches deep in the thigh or calf, with sharp pain when {he} puts full weight on it. {name} feels frustrated and vulnerable and walks stiff-legged, avoiding bending the knee.

{name}'s {part} is excruciating with every step, full of deep pulsing pressure, the toes cold. {name} is panicked, in agony and exhausted; {he} cannot put weight on the leg and drags it or needs support to move.
{name}'s {part} pulls tight and tears at the scab when {he} bends the knee or hip, and throbs heavily when {he} stands. {name} is weary of the slow recovery, limps, and needs to rest the leg raised.

{name}'s {part} is slightly stiff in the morning or the cold, the scar less flexible than the skin around it. {name} is relieved and regaining confidence, walking almost normally but hesitating before jumping or running.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again; the scar aches faintly in cold weather, a quiet reminder of the whipping.

levels: , a sudden, sharp slap of raw shock. The bite is clean and hot, an electric burst that rattles {his} nerves and makes {him} flinch, leaving a pulsing throb behind as {his} body scrambles to react.

across skin that is already tender. The dull ache spikes into a searing, white-hot flash as the lash digs into swollen, inflamed flesh, driving the breath from {his} lungs and turning a sore spot into radiating fire.

, and the blow tears open knitting skin and crushes half-healed muscle. The steady throb becomes a blinding, nauseating jolt that drops straight into {his} gut, breaking {his} composure and forcing an involuntary gasp or moan from {him}.

, and it is too much. The strike feels less like pain than demolition, a whiteout of primal agony that throws {him} into shock: the blood drains from {his} face, cold sweat breaks out, {his} vision tunnels, and {he} loses all control of {his} body.

stage.medium: The open lacerations on {name}'s {part} have closed into deep, bruised welts.
stage.light: The welts on {name}'s {part} have faded to sore red marks.
stage.recovering: The wounds on {name}'s {part} have scabbed over.
stage.mostly_healed: The scabs on {name}'s {part} have fallen away, leaving pink scar tissue.
stage.healed: The pink scar tissue on {name}'s {part} has faded to a faint, pale scar line; that wound has fully healed.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s whip wounds have healed.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} welts, wounds, and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} welts, wounds, and pain.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s welts is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} welts, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s whip wounds are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s whip wounds are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s whip wounds are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} wounds are {progress}.
